jobs.description: ALLWEILER GmbH – a subsidiary of Circor – is one of the most successful companies in the global pump industry. Our long expertise (since 1860), our high-quality standards in combination with advanced construction and pump technology are the basis for our growth. Our own sales companies and distributors in Europe, USA, Asia, Africa and the Middle East assure a high degree of customer satisfaction. We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) to join our team. The role can be based at our offices in Radolfzell am Bodensee, Germany, or Uxbridge, UK, with remote working also available within Germany or the UK. The person will report directly to the Sr. Director Global Talent Acquisition and functionally to the VP HR Industrial EMEA & APAC. Your Core Responsibilities Full Life Cycle Recruitment: Manage all aspects of the recruitment process across different departments, handling 15+ requisitions at a time. Client Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers and HR teams across Germany and Europe (Italy, France, Norway, UK), ensuring a deep understanding of their talent needs and company culture Sourcing & Talent Pool Development: Use a variety of sourcing strategies to build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for both technical and non-technical roles. Candidate Screening & Evaluation: Conduct in-depth interviews and assessments to evaluate candidates’ qualifications, skills, and cultural fit, providing feedback to clients and recommending top talent. Process Improvement: Continuously assess and improve recruitment processes to enhance the candidate experience, streamline workflows, and increase efficiency. Identify new tools, techniques, and strategies to attract top talent. Reporting & Documentation: Keep detailed records of candidate interactions, recruitment progress, and performance metrics. Provide regular updates to key stakeholders. Talent Development Coordination: Support Talent Development initiatives, including annual Organizational & Talent Reviews, employee engagement efforts (e.g., annual Pulse Survey), and culture enhancement programs. Our Requirements Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Psychology, Business, Engineering, or a related field. At least 3 years of experience in agency recruitment or in-house talent acquisition, managing full-cycle recruitment processes, specializing in Engineering, Sales, Finance, Lean Manufacturing, and Supply Chain roles. Expertise in sourcing, screening, and placing candidates for technical and non-technical roles Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence and collaborate with key stakeholders at all levels. Proficiency in using sourcing tools and recruitment technologies (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, ATS systems). The ability to manage multiple requisitions, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. Strong communication and interviewing skills and the ability to assess technical qualifications as well as cultural fit. Fluent in German and English. Our Benefits Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to work with leading diverse industry that’s growing and evolving. Flexible and dynamic work environment that fosters growth, innovation, and career development. A collaborative, supportive team culture that values your expertise and ideas. Flexible working hours due to flextime Please note: the benefits may vary from country to country. Sie versteht sich als offener und wertschätzender Ort der Begegnung, an dem Glaube, Kultur und soziale Verantwortung zusammenkommen. Die Gemeinde nutzt unterschiedliche Gebäude und Räume für kirchliche Feiern, Bildungsangebote und gemeinschaftliches Miteinander. Mitarbeitende finden hier ein sinnstiftendes Umfeld mit klaren Strukturen und einem engagierten Team, das die täglichen Abläufe im Gemeindealltag trägt. Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit: Sicherer und wertschätzender Umgang mit verschiedenen Personengruppen, Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit kirchlichen Mitarbeitenden und Freiwilligen. Zusätzliche Qualifikationen: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem handwerklichen, technischen oder hauswirtschaftlichen Beruf von Vorteil; Erfahrung in einer Kirchgemeinde oder vergleichbarer Institution wünschenswert; gute Deutschkenntnisse und Identifikation mit den Werten einer evangelischen Kirchgemeinde.

- Sichere Anwendung von Statistik- und QDA-Software (SPSS/R, MAXQDA) und Literaturverwaltung (Zotero) sowie von Office365, Kollaborations- und Videokonferenztools
- Fundierte Kenntnisse des aktuellen Forschungsstands zu pflegerischer Versorgung im Kontext Alter(n), Caring Communities, pflegerische und medizinische Versorgung im ländlichen Raum
